part1.intro: The examiner asks the candidate about him/herself, his/her home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Travelling to work or college
questions: How do you usually travel to work or college? [Why?]
Have you always travelled to work/college in the same way? [Why/Why not?]
What do you like about travelling to work/college this way?
What changes would improve the way you travel to work/college? [Why?]

part2.topic: Describe a piece of electronic equipment that you find useful.
points: how you learned to use it
how long you have had it
part2.closing: and explain why you find this piece of electronic equipment useful.

topics.title: Technology and housework
questions: What kinds of machine are used for housework in modern homes in your country?
How have these machines benefited people? Are there any negative effects of using them?
Do you think all new homes will be equipped with household machines in the future? Why?

topics.title: Technology in the workplace
questions: What kinds of equipment do most workers need to use in offices today?
How have developments in technology affected employment in your country?
Some people think that technology has brought more stress than benefits to employed people nowadays. Would you agree or disagree? Why?
